tagline: Mutual fund finder · official AMFI data
iosInstallTip: On iPhone or iPad: tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen” to install Analyx.
heroTitle: Find funds that fit your goal
heroSub: Tell us your goal, risk comfort and time frame. We rank Direct-Growth funds within each SEBI category using official NAV data, and show where every number comes from.
assumedReturnHint: Your own assumption for the projection — not a prediction.
describeLabel: Describe what you want, in English, Hindi or Hinglish
describePlaceholder: e.g. SIP of ₹10,000 a month for 20 years, medium risk, I am 32
examples: SIP ₹10,000 a month for 20 years, medium risk, I am 28|Lump sum ₹5 lakh for retirement, 25 years, high risk|Child education, ₹15,000 monthly SIP, 15 years, age 34|Emergency fund ₹2 lakh one time, low risk
voiceIntro: Tap the mic and say your goal, amount, time frame, risk and age. Speak in the language selected at the top (English or Hindi).
transcript: What we heard (you can edit it)
voiceUnsupported: Voice input isn't supported in this browser. Please use Chrome or Edge, or type in “Describe in words”.
listening: Listening… tap the mic again when you're done.
doneListening: Got it. Check the text, then confirm below.
micDenied: Microphone permission was blocked. Allow the microphone for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
noSpeech: We didn't hear anything. Tap the mic and try again.
micError: Voice input stopped unexpectedly. Please try again or type instead.
parseNothing: We couldn't pick out any details. Try something like: “SIP of ₹5,000 a month for 10 years, low risk”.
weUnderstood: Here's what we understood. Please check it:
ttsUnsupported: Read-aloud isn't supported in this browser.
noHindiVoice: No Hindi voice is installed on this device, so a default voice is reading. You can add a Hindi voice in your phone's text-to-speech settings.
note55: Age 55+: small and mid cap funds are left out; low-risk investors get hybrid funds instead of pure equity.
noteH1: Time frame of 1 year or less: only liquid and overnight funds are suitable.
noteH3: Time frame of 3 years or less: only short-term debt funds are shown.
noteElssLock: ELSS funds have a 3-year lock-in. Your time frame is shorter than that.
fewerFunds: Only {n} funds qualified after the rules (minimum 3 years of history, at most 2 per fund house).
corpusNote: Assumes {ret} a year (your input) and {inf} inflation. Real returns will differ — this is maths, not a forecast.
explainNote: Written automatically from the numbers on this page. No AI, no guesses.
noFunds: No ranked funds matched these categories in today's data.
resultsSource: Data: AMFI NAVs as of {date}, history from mfapi.in, computed on {built}.
whyRankHelp: Each bar shows how this fund compares with others in its category (100 = best). Your risk level decides how much each bar counts.
dataMissing: Fund data hasn't been built yet. If you run this site, open the Actions tab on GitHub and run “Update data and publish”.
enterAmount: Please enter an amount of at least ₹100.
mx.return_1y: Change in NAV over the last 12 months.
mx.sharpe: Return above the risk-free rate per unit of volatility (36 months). Higher is better.
mx.sortino: Like Sharpe, but only counts downside moves. Higher is better.
mx.alpha: Yearly return beyond what its market exposure (beta) explains, versus the benchmark.
mx.beta: How much the fund moves when its benchmark moves. 1 = same as the market.
mx.std_dev: Annualised standard deviation of monthly returns (36 months). Lower is steadier.
mx.max_drawdown_3y: Biggest drop from a peak in the last 3 years.
mx.max_drawdown_all: Biggest drop from a peak since this plan started.
mx.consistency: Share of rolling 3-year periods in which the fund beat its benchmark.
terAumEx: No free official feed we could verify. Check the fund's latest factsheet.
detailError: Couldn't load this fund's details. Check your connection and try again.
detailSources: Sources: official NAV from AMFI (as of {date}); history since {since} from mfapi.in.
noBench: No free benchmark exists for this category, so alpha, beta and consistency aren't shown.
benchSub: Measured from the NAV of a real index fund that tracks each index, so the numbers include that fund's small costs.
about.nav: Scheme list, categories and latest NAVs (as of {date}):
about.hist: Daily NAV history, cross-checked against AMFI's latest NAV:
about.counts: {ranked} Direct-Growth funds with 3+ years of history were ranked out of {universe} checked. Data rebuilt on {built}.
about.method: Returns use dates, not row counts. Risk figures use the last 36 complete months. Funds are scored by percentile against peers in the same SEBI category.
about.na: When a number can't be computed from these sources, we show “Not available” instead of guessing.
sampleData: Demo data — run the data update to see real funds.
staleData: Fund data may be out of date: latest NAV is from {date}.
disclaimer: Analyx is a decision-support tool, not investment advice, and is not registered with SEBI. Past returns do not guarantee future returns. Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks; read all scheme documents carefully and consult a SEBI-registered adviser before investing.
ex.intro: For a {goal} goal with {risk} risk over {years} years, Analyx looked at {cats}. It ranked {count} Direct-Growth funds in these categories using NAVs up to {date}.
ex.top: The top pick is {name} ({cat}). It ranks {rank} out of {peers} funds in its category, with a score of {score} out of 100.
ex.vsBench: Over the last 3 years it grew {r3} a year, compared with {b3} a year for the {bench} index.
ex.r3: Over the last 3 years it grew {r3} a year.
ex.risk: Its worst fall in the last 3 years was {dd} from a peak. Be ready for drops like this.
ex.corpusSip: Investing {amount} a month for {years} years means putting in {invested}. At your assumed {ret} a year, that could grow to about {value} — roughly {real} in today's money after {inf} inflation.
ex.corpusLump: A one-time {amount} left for {years} years, at your assumed {ret} a year, could grow to about {value} — roughly {real} in today's money after {inf} inflation.
ex.tipSip: Tip: keep the SIP running through market falls; buying at lower prices helps over the long run.
ex.tipLump: Tip: for a large one-time amount in equity funds, many investors spread it out over a few months using an STP from a liquid fund.
ex.tipShort: For short time frames, protecting capital matters more than chasing returns.
ex.tipLong: Review once a year, not every day. Spread money across 2–3 funds from different fund houses.
sp.fund: Number {n}: {name}. Category {cat}. Ranked {rank} of {peers}. Three-year return {r3} a year. One-year return {r1}. Worst fall in three years {dd}.
sp.topIntro: Here are the top three funds.
sp.detail: {name}. {cat}. Ranked {rank} of {peers} in its category. One-year return {r1}. Three-year return {r3} a year. Five-year return {r5} a year. Worst fall in three years {dd}. Volatility {sd}.
note46: Age 46–55: small cap funds are left out.
noteH5: A time frame of 5 years or less is short for small and mid caps, so they are left out and balanced advantage funds are added.
noteRecord: For long-term equity goals, only funds with at least 5 years of history are shown, so a short lucky run can't top the list.
riskWeighting.Conservative: Because you chose low risk, funds that fell least and moved most steadily count for more.
riskWeighting.Moderate: Returns and risk are weighed evenly for medium risk.
riskWeighting.Aggressive: Because you chose high risk, long-term growth and alpha count for more than small falls.
staleMacro: The inflation figure used is from {period} and may be out of date.
about.verified: Every published figure ({n} of them) was recomputed independently and checked against AMFI's official NAV history on {date}. If any figure disagrees, the nightly update is not published.
